DEPARTMENT OF STUDENT WELFARE
IIMT UNIVERSITY, MEERUT
NOTICE: MERIT-CUM-MEANS SCHOLARSHIP 2026-27
Circular Ref: IIMTU/DSW/2026/SCH-042
Date: 10 October 2026

Applications are invited from eligible students for the Merit-cum-Means Financial Assistance Scholarship for the Academic Year 2026-27.

1. PURPOSE:
To support meritorious undergraduate students encountering financial hardship to pursue their higher technical education.

2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
- Currently enrolled as full-time 2nd or 3rd year B.Tech or B.Sc Computer Science students.
- Minimum cumulative score of 75% or 7.5 CGPA in preceding semesters.
- Annual gross family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 5,00,000 (Rupees Five Lakhs).

3. APPLICATION FEE:
There is NO application fee for this scholarship. Beware of unauthorized intermediaries.

4. REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
Applicants must attach self-attested copies of the following documents:
a) Previous semester mark sheets (Semesters 1 through 4).
b) Valid Family Income Certificate issued by the Tehsildar or Revenue Authority.
c) College Identity Card and Aadhar Card.
d) First page of student bank passbook showing IFSC code and Account Number.

5. IMPORTANT DATES & DEADLINE:
- Online application portal opens: 15 October 2026.
- Final submission deadline: 15 November 2026, 5:00 PM IST.

6. APPLICATION PROCEDURE:
Complete the online submission form at https://scholarships.iimtu.edu.in and print the confirmation page. Submit one signed physical copy along with document photocopies to Room 204, Administrative Block.

7. CONTACT & INQUIRIES:
Dean of Student Welfare Office
Room 204, Administrative Block, IIMT University, Meerut
Email: dsw-helpdesk@iimtu.edu.in | Phone: 0121-2405000

NOTE: Late submission policy is not specified in this notification. Incomplete submissions without income proof will be summarily rejected.
